name: GMX Alphanumeric Only Character Count Step
overview: Tallies the [GMX-V 2.0](http://www.xtm-intl.com/manuals/gmx-v/GMX-V-2.0.html) `AlphanumericOnlyTextUnitCharacterCount` category — the character count for text units that contain only alphanumeric words. Each text unit's source is tokenised and a unit qualifies only when every non-whitespace token is one of the recognised alphanumeric kinds (`ABBREVIATION`, `EMAIL`, `INTERNET`, `COMPANY`, `EMOTICON`, `MARKUP`); units mixing in any other token type contribute zero. Characters are counted in canonical form — whitespace and punctuation are excluded (hyphens and apostrophes inside words are kept) — and stored as GMX-V metrics annotations for downstream consumption (for example by the Scoping Report Step). This is the character-count counterpart of the alphanumeric-only word-count step.
processingNotes: A text unit is counted only if all of its tokens are alphanumeric-kind tokens plus whitespace; otherwise the unit yields zero.
Counts are computed over the source content; only translatable text units are counted.
Character counting excludes whitespace and punctuation per GMX-V, but retains hyphens and apostrophes that occur inside a word.
